list.query: SELECT __value, __text FROM (SELECT c.id AS __value, COALESCE(c.name, 'VIN ' || c.vin, 'Voiture ' || c.id) AS __text, (SELECT max(p.date) FROM positions p WHERE p.car_id = c.id AND p.ideal_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL) AS last_seen FROM cars c) x ORDER BY last_seen DESC NULLS LAST, __value DESC

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(sg.name, CONCAT_WS(', ', COALESCE(sa.name, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', sa.road, sa.house_number), '')), COALESCE(sa.city, sa.neighbourhood))) AS "Départ", COALESCE(eg.name, CONCAT_WS(', ', COALESCE(ea.name, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', ea.road, ea.house_number), '')), COALESCE(ea.city, ea.neighbourhood))) AS "Arrivée", d.distance AS "Distance", d.duration_min AS "Durée",
  (d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km - d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km) * car.efficiency AS "Énergie",
  (d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km - d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km) * car.efficiency * 100 / nullif(d.distance, 0) AS "Conso",
  d.distance / nullif(d.duration_min, 0) * 60 AS "Vitesse moyenne", d.speed_max AS "Vitesse max",
  sp.battery_level AS "SOC départ", ep.battery_level AS "SOC arrivée", d.ascent AS "Montée", d.descent AS "Descente",
  d.outside_temp_avg AS "Temp. ext.", d.inside_temp_avg AS "Temp. int.", d.power_max AS "Puissance max", -d.power_min AS "Régénération max",
  d.distance / nullif(d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km - d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km, 0) * 100 AS "Efficacité",
  d.start_km AS "Odomètre"
FROM drives d JOIN cars car ON car.id = d.car_id
  LEFT JOIN addresses sa ON sa.id = d.start_address_id LEFT JOIN addresses ea ON ea.id = d.end_address_id
  LEFT JOIN geofences sg ON sg.id = d.start_geofence_id LEFT JOIN geofences eg ON eg.id = d.end_geofence_id
  LEFT JOIN positions sp ON sp.id = d.start_position_id LEFT JOIN positions ep ON ep.id = d.end_position_id WHERE d.id = $drive_id

panels.title: Efficacité
panels.description: Km parcourus ÷ km d'autonomie consommés (100 % = tu as roulé exactement comme l'estimation EPA de la voiture).

targets.rawSql: SELECT date AS time, latitude, longitude, speed AS "Vitesse" FROM positions WHERE drive_id = $drive_id ORDER BY date
SELECT date AS time, speed AS "Vitesse", power AS "Puissance" FROM positions WHERE drive_id = $drive_id ORDER BY date

SELECT date AS time, battery_level AS "Batterie", usable_battery_level AS "Batterie utilisable", ${preferred_range}_battery_range_km AS "Autonomie"
FROM positions WHERE drive_id = $drive_id ORDER BY date
SELECT date AS time, elevation AS "Altitude" FROM positions WHERE drive_id = $drive_id ORDER BY date

SELECT date AS time, outside_temp AS "Extérieur", inside_temp AS "Habitacle", driver_temp_setting AS "Consigne"
FROM positions WHERE drive_id = $drive_id ORDER BY date

WITH p AS (SELECT speed, extract(epoch FROM lead(date) OVER (ORDER BY date) - date) AS s FROM positions WHERE drive_id = $drive_id)
SELECT (floor(speed / 10) * 10)::int || ' km/h' AS "Vitesse", sum(s) / 60 AS "Minutes"
FROM p WHERE speed > 0 AND s IS NOT NULL GROUP BY floor(speed / 10) ORDER BY floor(speed / 10)

SELECT date AS time, tpms_pressure_fl AS "Avant gauche", tpms_pressure_fr AS "Avant droit",
  tpms_pressure_rl AS "Arrière gauche", tpms_pressure_rr AS "Arrière droit"
FROM positions WHERE drive_id = $drive_id AND tpms_pressure_fl IS NOT NULL ORDER BY date
